recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a human wants to reconstruct archived DSTU1/DSTU2 publication history outside the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-5459 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DataElement ballot issue for DSTU1 section 6.21.3.7. The ballot comment said the section was still missing, the disposition was to add it, and the final resolution says the section had been completed.
initial_application: No current commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5459 was found. Historical DataElement source did receive DataElement narrative and notes updates during the 2015 application window, and the old notes material was retained until DataElement was retired.
additional_context: DataElement is no longer an active current-build resource. The current source/fhir.ini comments out the DataElement resource, work group, TLA, FMM, and mapping entries. Git history shows commit 29576ed0ef removed DataElement from the build in 2017, and commit 33b409a4b6 later deleted the old source/dataelement files during the R4B source rework. Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Created an empty audit commit and made no source changes because the requested DSTU1 DataElement narrative section has no active current-spec source location to edit.
